newsitem.title: USA: Hyperion Telecommunications to sell $200 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Hyperion Telecommunications to sell $200 mln debt.

text.p: Aldephia Communications Corp announced on Thursday that its subsidariay, Hyperion Telecommunciations Inc, plans to sell $200 million in seven-year senior secured notes in a 144a private placement.
Net proeceeds from the sale will be used to increase Hyperion's ownership interest in certain of its networks and to continue the expansion of those networks, the company stated.
Bear Stearns & Co Inc will lead-manage the deal.
Co-managers will be Toronto Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, Bank of Nova Scotia and Chase Securities, a source familiar with the deal said.
The roadshow for the offering will start August 28. The deal is expected to price before Labor Day, the source added.
The offering is conditioned on Hyperion receiving consents from bondholders to amend covenants in the indenture of its 13 percent senior discount notes.
Hyperion is a competitive local exchange provider operating in various markets in the eastern half of the U.S.
Adelphia is the seventh largest cable television operator in the U.S.
